# COIN

Instructional videos with task and step annotations used in procedure forecasting.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** An instructional-video prefix and already completed procedural steps.

**Output / label:** The remaining procedure steps in the cited visual planning setup.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://github.com/coin-dataset/annotations)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://github.com/coin-dataset/annotations), [planning_paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.15130)

## Intention in this dataset

Forecast later procedural steps from an observed prefix in the cited planning study. Task categories supply procedure context, not self-reported personal intent.

**Relevance:** `implicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2019

**Domains:** daily_activities, human_object_interaction  
**Intention types:** action, task_goal  
**Tasks:** future_activity_prediction  
**Modalities:** rgb, text  
**Formats:** video, text, structured_annotation
